title: Rav Ika son of Rav Ami
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He lived in Rava’s time, as in Bava Kamma 149a: he taught Isur how to transfer his money, which was deposited with Rava, to his son Rav Mari, and Rava was displeased with him.
He is also mentioned in Bava Kamma 12a, Avodah Zarah 2a, Keritot 6b and Chullin 77b.

notes.text: The supplied first locator is Bava Kamma 149a, retained in the body. The matching money-transfer proposal of Rav Ika son of Rav Ami and Rava’s displeasure is in the William Davidson digital Bava Batra 149a; Bava Kamma does not have a folio 149. The relation to Isur and Rav Mari is kept in the direction supplied.
The consulted Bava Kamma, Keritot and Chullin passages name Rav Ika son of Rav Ami. The bounded check of Avodah Zarah 2a left that locator unresolved.
